title: On Stretching the rope between two posts
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：stretch　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stretch 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the porter ① stretched the rope between two posts in public, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the porter ② stretches the rope between two posts in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ stretch the rope between two posts at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ stretched the rope between two posts before — a line in the journal for August 1969 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Stretching the rope between two posts in public, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ stretch away to the hills in the west in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Stretch away to the hills in the west at once and never mention it again.

By 1982 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new visitor from the next coast ⑧ stretches away to the hills in the west in public every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cove, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ stretched the rope between two posts again when nobody else would.

⑩ To stretch the rope between two posts, my mother said in 1987, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the coast remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the coast forgets, somebody stretches the rope between two posts in silence again and somebody must stretch the rope between two posts in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 伸展（一般过去式 stretched the rope between two posts：1975 年挑夫头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 伸展（一般现在 stretches the rope between two posts：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 伸展（不定式 to stretch the rope between two posts：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 伸展（过去完成时 had stretched the rope between two posts：1969 年八月的行记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 伸展（动名词 stretching the rope between two posts 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 延伸（stretch away to the hills in the west：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去延伸一路往西的丘陵延伸开去）
G. v. 延伸（stretch away to the hills in the west：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 伸展（后段两处：新来的游客照例 stretches away to the hills in the west，而母亲又一次 stretched the rope between two posts）

answers.why: stretch 意为“伸展”，1975 年挑夫当着众人面伸展把绳子拉在两根柱子之间，那是海岸里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 stretched。
stretch 意为“伸展”，自那以后挑夫一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 stretches。
stretch 意为“伸展”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯伸展把绳子拉在两根柱子之间”，此处为不定式 to stretch the rope between two posts。
stretch 意为“伸展”，行记里 八月 那行字说明早在 1982 年之前就有人伸展过，故用过去完成时 had stretched。
stretch 意为“伸展”，挑夫说“伸展把绳子拉在两根柱子之间这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 stretching the rope between two posts 作主语。
stretch 意为“延伸”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去延伸一路往西的丘陵延伸开去”，should ever 之后用原形 stretch away to the hills in the west。
stretch 意为“延伸”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻延伸一路往西的丘陵延伸开去（stretch away to the hills in the west at once），以后再也不要提起。
stretch 意为“伸展”，新来的游客每个星期都照例延伸一路往西的丘陵延伸开去，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 stretches。
stretch 意为“伸展”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面伸展把绳子拉在两根柱子之间，用一般过去式 stretched 叙述。
stretch 意为“伸展”，结尾那句是母亲 1987 年的话：要伸展把绳子拉在两根柱子之间，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和海岸记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，挑夫当着众人面伸展把绳子拉在两根柱子之间；海岸里每一个游客都说这是头一回。（stretched the rope between two posts）
多年以后，挑夫仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（stretches the rope between two posts）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯伸展把绳子拉在两根柱子之间这件事本身。（to stretch the rope between two posts）
早在 1969 年就有人伸展把绳子拉在两根柱子之间，八月那天行记上的一行字就是证据。（had stretched the rope between two posts）
挑夫说过，当着众人面伸展把绳子拉在两根柱子之间这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（stretching the rope between two posts 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻延伸一路往西的丘陵延伸开去，以后再也不要提起。（stretch away to the hills in the west，祈使句）

My mother said later that to stretch the rope between two posts at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had stretched the rope between two posts long before 1982, and the line in the journal for August proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 stretch 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the porter stretched the rope between two posts in public, and nobody in the coast forgot it.
Even now the porter stretches the rope between two posts in silence whenever the coast asks.
Stretching the rope between two posts in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever stretch away to the hills in the west in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next coast stretches away to the hills in the west in public every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother stretched the rope between two posts again, and the coast remembered that half.
